name: chronology
title: Draft chronology: internal lawyer review
for_each: select id,code from matters order by code

sections.title: Matter
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,purpose from matters where id=$1

sections.title: Facts
sections.sql: select code,occurred_on,date_precision,fact,position,current_support,stale_citations,conflicts from v_chronology where matter_id=$1 order by occurred_on nulls last,code

sections.title: Evidence references
sections.note: This internal document can contain confidential and privileged material. It is not cleared for disclosure.
sections.sql: select f.code as fact,s.code as source,s.name,c.pinpoint,c.stance,s.confidentiality from citations c join facts f on f.id=c.fact_id join sources s on s.id=c.source_id where c.matter_id=$1 order by f.code,s.code

name: issue-outline
title: Draft issue outline
for_each: select id,code from matters order by code

sections.title: Issue evidence
sections.sql: select code,issue,owner,facts,reviewed_supported,contested from v_issue_proof where matter_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Open work
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,due_on from tasks where matter_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_on

name: witness-brief
title: Draft witness preparation brief
for_each: select id,code from witnesses order by code

sections.title: Witness
sections.sql: select code,name,role from witnesses where id=$1

sections.title: Linked facts
sections.sql: select f.code,f.occurred_on,f.fact,f.current_support,f.conflicts from fact_witnesses l join v_chronology f on f.id=l.fact_id where l.witness_id=$1 order by f.occurred_on nulls last,f.code

sections.title: Evidence references
sections.note: Internal review only. Never send automatically.
sections.sql: select f.code,s.name,c.pinpoint,c.stance,s.confidentiality from fact_witnesses l join facts f on f.id=l.fact_id join citations c on c.fact_id=f.id join sources s on s.id=c.source_id where l.witness_id=$1 order by f.code,s.name
